data.body:
LANDED and closed.

Gerrit change 1520 (patch set 2) MERGED as `a55b93a0f55777c467458a0e1f0ccc6a4971f28d`, now the tip of both Gerrit main and the GitHub mirror. Votes: LLM-Review +1 (PASS, 4 advisory / 0 blocking), Verified +1.

CI note for the record: patch set 1 took two Verified-1s from `tests/unit/test_opcert_service_app.py::test_matching_guard_is_accepted - worker 'gw3' crashed` on ubuntu/py3.11 only (py3.12, py3.13 and macOS all green, 11316 tests passing each time). It was NOT this change: the file is the opcert FastAPI service, untouched here, and it passes locally in 0.88s under the exact `--timeout=300 --timeout-method=thread` hang guard, so it was not a 300s timeout. A local full-suite run under CI's exact `-n 4 --dist worksteal --timeout=300` configuration produced no worker crash at all. The same patch set, rebased onto newer main with no content change, then passed py3.11 in 11m42s. Reading: a runner-side worker death (the crashed worker is also what produced the bogus `Coverage failure: total of 15` line — the run itself reports the failed workers returned no coverage data). Worth watching as a py3.11 CI stability item; it is a plausible follow-up ticket if it recurs on unrelated changes.

Acceptance criteria, all four met and checked:
1. Baseline advances to the value rebar pushed — `peer_state.merge_baseline` overlays confirmed pushes on top of the pass-start fetch in `_advance_baselines`.
2. ABA reproduced end to end and proven RED first — with the fix neutered (signatures kept, overlay no-op'd) all five ABA cells fail; restored, all pass.
3. ADR 0026 behaviour held firm — five held-firm cells assert a genuine Jira-side edit still suppresses outbound and flows inbound; they stayed green through the neutering, so they are pinning the deliberate behaviour and not the fix.
4. Applied to all five inbound-mirrored fields, with the one honest limitation documented and tested: an assignee pushed via the 264f accountId fast path records `{accountId: ...}`, which will not match a local email/display name, so that sub-case falls back to local-wins rather than fabricating an identity we never observed. Safe direction, pinned by test.
